items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: He used to play with Judy Forstain. Oh yeah. But I took him away from Judy Forstain and got him with Ali.

ctx.x: Ask him about Albert Martin. How about Albert Martin?

Albert Martin? Well, he used to play with me and Ali when he was there. He used to play with Judy Forstain. Oh yeah. But I took him away from Judy Forstain and got him with Ali. And then he played with other bands after I didn't rent. I left my rent to Mexico. Then when I come back, my job was right there for me. But then after that, I didn't get a break with fake Marvel. And he said he was going to take it like I take and rent to Mexico. And that's why we all separated. And Albert, he went to Texas. The family…
Oh Little Joe? you know. I remember playing. Yeah.
